info.name: DealFlow360 — Backend API (T0–T7)
info.description:
Every backend endpoint implemented so far: Catalog (products/categories), Customers & Tiers, Pricing, Discount & Approval governance config, and the Quotation Builder + Blended Risk / Submit flow.

## Before you run anything
1. `docker compose up -d` (Postgres + Redis) and `npm run dev`.
2. `npm run prisma:seed` — creates the CustomerTier examples **and 4 fixed dev users** (one per role) that this collection authenticates as. Their ids are already filled in as collection variables (`devAdminId`, `devSalesRepId`, `devManagerId`, `devFinanceOpsId`).

## How auth works here
Real login is Clerk-based (`@clerk/nextjs`), which needs a browser session — not practical from Postman. Every request in this collection instead sends an `x-dev-user-id` header with the **internal `users.id`** of one of the 4 seeded dev accounts. `src/lib/auth/resolve-actor.ts` looks that row up in Postgres and uses **its** role/customerId — the header only selects *which* already-seeded user to act as, it can't grant a role that user doesn't have. This bypass is hard-disabled when `NODE_ENV=production` (see resolve-actor.ts); on a real deploy the same code path resolves the actor from an actual Clerk session instead.

## How to run it
Folders are numbered in dependency order — run top to bottom once (Postman "Run collection" works too). Each request's Tests tab captures the ids it creates into collection variables (`categoryHardwareId`, `productLaptopId`, `quotationId`, `quotationVersion`, ...) so later requests can reference them automatically — you shouldn't need to copy/paste any id by hand. Folder 05 is the star flow: it reproduces the exact TAD SS10 "Gold customer" example (Laptop 12%/15% ceiling = compliant, Setup Service 18%/10% ceiling = 8pp violation) end to end, and the final Submit call should come back MEDIUM-banded and PENDING_APPROVAL.

item.name: 00 - Health
item.description: No auth required — infra check only (T0.1).

request.description:
**Auth:** none.

**Input:** none.

**Output (200):**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "app": "healthy",
  "database": { "status": "healthy" },
  "queue": { "status": "healthy" },
  "timestamp": "2026-09-05T11:17:29.418Z"
}
```
`queue.status` can independently show `"degraded"` if Redis is down — that never blocks business logic, only the queue-dependent (P1) features.

item.name: 01 - Catalog (Categories & Products)
item.description: Admin-only writes, any internal role can read (T2.1). Creates the Hardware/Services categories and Laptop/Setup Service products used by every later folder.

request.description:
**Auth:** ADMIN only (`requireAdmin`).

**Input:** `name` (required), `description` (optional).

**Output (201):**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "...", "name": "Hardware", "description": "Physical hardware products", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." } }
```
Captures `id` into `categoryHardwareId`.
Same shape as above. Captures `id` into `categoryServicesId` — this is the category T3.1's 10% ceiling gets attached to later, and that the Setup Service product belongs to.
**Auth:** any internal role (`requireInternal`). **Output (200):** `{ "data": [ {category}, ... ] }`, alphabetical by name.
**Output (200):** the single category. **404 NOT_FOUND** if the id doesn't exist.
**Auth:** ADMIN only. Partial update — any subset of `name`/`description`. **Output (200):** the updated category.

**Auth:** ADMIN only.

**Input:** `categoryId`, `sku`, `name`, `price`, `unit`, `taxPct` required; `costPrice` (added for T6.4's margin calc — defaults to 0), `description`, `isSubscription`/`recurringCycle`, `variants[]`, `isActive` optional.

**Output (201):**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "...", "category": {...}, "sku": "LAPTOP-001", "name": "Laptop", "price": "1000.00", "costPrice": "700.00", "unit": "unit", "taxPct": "0", "isActive": true, "variants": [], ... } }
```
Captures `id` into `productLaptopId`. This is the TAD SS10 Gold-example "Laptop" line (12% discount against a 15% ceiling — compliant).
Captures `id` into `productSetupServiceId`. This is the Gold-example line that gets **flagged** (18% discount against a 10% category ceiling — 8 percentage points of excess).
**Query (optional):** `active` (true/false), `categoryId`. **Output (200):** `{ "data": [ {product}, ... ] }`.
**Output (200):** the single product with its variants.
**Auth:** ADMIN only. Partial update of any product field. **Output (200):** updated product.
A disposable product just to demonstrate delete below — not used by any later folder.

**Auth:** ADMIN only. **Output: 204 No Content.** Note: this is a *soft* delete — the repository sets `isActive: false` rather than removing the row (historical quotation lines must keep referencing it).

item.name: 02 - Customers & Customer Tiers
item.description: Admin-only writes, any internal role can read (T2.2).

request.description: **Output (200):** `{ "data": [ {id, name, createdAt, updatedAt}, ... ] }`. `npm run prisma:seed` creates Bronze/Silver/Gold as **examples only** — the app never hardcodes tier names. This request's Test script finds the row named `Gold` and stores its id as `tierGoldId`, since the rest of the collection quotes a Gold customer (matching the TAD SS10 example).
**Auth:** ADMIN only. **Input:** `name` (unique). **Output (201):** the created tier. Captures `id` into `tierScratchId` (used for the PATCH/DELETE demos below only).
**Output (200):** the single tier. **404 NOT_FOUND** otherwise.
**Output (200):** updated tier.
**Output: 204 No Content.**

**Auth:** ADMIN only.

**Input:** `name`, `tierId` required; `primaryContactEmail` optional.

**Output (201):**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "...", "name": "Acme Corp", "tierId": "...", "primaryContactEmail": "buyer@acme.test", "tier": { "id": "...", "name": "Gold" }, ... } }
```
Captures `id` into `customerId` — this is the customer every quotation below is built for.
**Output (200):** `{ "data": [ {customer}, ... ] }`.
**Output (200):** the single customer.
**Output (200):** updated customer.
Run this, then run the DELETE request right after it (same folder) to see the 204 response. Captures id into `customerScratchId`.
**Output: 204 No Content.**

item.name: 03 - Pricing (Price Lists)
item.description: T2.3 — the canonical price lookup. `resolvePrice` here is the exact function the Quotation Builder calls internally; nothing else re-derives price.

request.description:
**Auth:** ADMIN only.

**Input:** `name`, `tierId`, `currency` (3-letter), `items[]` (`productId`, optional `variantId`, `unitPrice`) — at least one item, no duplicate product/variant scope.

**Output (201):** the price list with resolved item names. **409 CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT** if a rule for this exact tier+currency+product+variant already exists (an overlap the DoD explicitly tests). Captures `id` into `priceListId` — every quotation below is created against this price list.
**Query (optional):** `tierId`, `currency`, `active`. **Output (200):** `{ "data": [ {priceList}, ... ] }`.

item.name: GET /api/price-lists?resolve — resolve Laptop's price for Gold/USD

request.description:
Presence of `productId`/`customerTierId` switches this GET into the resolver instead of the list. **Output (200):**
```json
{ "data": { "priceListId": "...", "customerTierId": "...", "productId": "...", "variantId": null, "currency": "USD", "baseUnitPrice": "1000.00", "variantExtraPrice": "0.00", "unitPrice": "1000.00", "matchedRule": "PRODUCT" } }
```
**404 NOT_FOUND** if no active price resolves (inactive product/variant, or no rule for this tier+currency+product) — this is the same rule enforced when adding a quotation line.

item.name: 04 - Discount & Approval Governance (Epic 3)
item.description: Admin-only config: discount ceilings (T3.1) and the risk-band -> approval-chain mapping (T3.2). Both are read-only, canonical lookups for the Quotation Builder/Submit flow — nothing downstream re-implements this logic.

request.description:
**Auth:** ADMIN only.

**Input:** `scope` (`TIER`|`CATEGORY`), matching `tierId` or `categoryId`, `maxDiscountPct` (0-100), `isActive`.

**Output (201):** the rule, `maxDiscountPct` echoed back as `"15"` (stored as a 0-1 fraction, spoken as 0-100 at the API boundary). **409 CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT** if an active rule already exists for this tier/category (DB partial-unique-index backstop). Captures `id` into `discountRuleTierId`.

This is the ceiling that makes the Setup Service line violate in the Gold-fixture walkthrough: 10% is lower than the 15% tier ceiling, so TAD SS10's "lower ceiling wins" rule picks this one for any Services-category line. Captures `id` into `discountRuleCategoryId`.
**Auth:** any internal role. **Query (optional):** `scope`, `tierId`, `categoryId`, `active`.
**Output (200):** the single rule.

**Note the verb is PUT, not PATCH**, for this resource. `scope`/`tierId`/`categoryId` are immutable after creation (recreate the rule to retarget it) — only `maxDiscountPct`/`isActive`/`reason` are editable; any subset can be sent. This example deliberately leaves `maxDiscountPct` at 15 (unset = unchanged) so the ceiling used by folder 05's Gold-fixture walkthrough further down stays exactly 15%.

This IS `resolveDiscountCeiling` (T3.1) — the exact function the Submit flow (T7.2) calls per line.

**Output (200) — reproduces the TAD SS10 Gold example exactly:**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "tierId": "...", "categoryId": "...",
    "tierCeilingPct": "15",
    "categoryCeilingPct": "10",
    "allowedDiscountPct": "10",
    "limitingScope": "CATEGORY"
  }
}
```
`allowedDiscountPct` is the *lower* of the two — "if both tier and category ceilings exist, use the lower ceiling."

item.name: [Cleanup demo] POST scratch tier for this demo

request.description: A dedicated, never-deleted-elsewhere tier so this demo doesn't depend on folder 02's Platinum scratch tier (which folder 02 already deletes). Captures id into `discountRuleScratchTierId`.

item.name: [Cleanup demo] POST + DELETE scratch discount rule

request.description: Captures id into `discountRuleScratchId` for the DELETE demo below.
**Output: 204 No Content.**

**Auth:** ADMIN only.

**Input:** `riskBand` (`LOW`|`MEDIUM`|`HIGH`, unique — one rule per band ever), `steps[]` (`stepOrder` contiguous from 1, `role`). Validation rejects duplicate/gapped step orders and a Finance step preceding a Manager step.

**Output (201):** the rule with its ordered steps. Captures `id` into `approvalRuleMediumId` — this is the chain the Gold-fixture Submit call routes to.
TAD SS11: HIGH band is a two-stage chain, Manager before Finance.
An empty `steps[]` is what makes Submit auto-APPROVE instead of routing to PENDING_APPROVAL.
**Query (optional):** `riskBand`, `active`.
**Output (200):** the single rule with its steps.
**Note the verb is PUT, not PATCH.** `riskBand` is immutable after creation.

item.name: 05 - Quotation Builder -> Submit (TAD SS10 Gold Fixture)
item.description: The full T6.1-T6.5 + T7.1-T7.2 flow as one Sales Rep, reproducing the exact documented example: Laptop 12% (vs 15% ceiling, compliant) + Setup Service 18% (vs 10% ceiling, 8pp violation) -> flagged MEDIUM -> routed to Manager approval.

request.description:
**Auth:** SALES_REP only (TAD SS6: "Create and revise assigned quotations" is Sales-Rep-only; Manager/Finance get Read, Admin has none by default). The created quotation's `salesRepId` is always the caller — never client-supplied.

**Input:** `customerId`, `priceListId` (must belong to the customer's tier, or `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`).

**Output (201):**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "...", "code": "QT-000045", "status": "DRAFT", "version": 1, "lines": [], "summary": { "netBeforeTax": "0.00", "totalCost": "0.00", "marginAmount": "0.00", "marginPct": null }, ... } }
```
Captures `quotationId` and `quotationVersion` (starts at 1).

item.name: GET /api/quotations — list (Sales Rep, scoped to own)

request.description: **Query (optional):** `status`, `customerId`, `salesRepId`. A SALES_REP's `salesRepId` is silently forced to their own id server-side — passing someone else's id in the query does nothing (TAD SS6: "IDs supplied by the browser... never establish ownership"). MANAGER/FINANCE_OPS/ADMIN can filter or see all reps' quotations.
**Output (200):** the full quotation. `summary`/each line's `effectiveDiscountPct`/`marginPct` are **always recomputed live** (T6.5), never read from a stored column.

**Auth:** SALES_REP, must own this Draft quotation (`403 FORBIDDEN`/`409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` otherwise).

**Input:** `expectedVersion` (optimistic concurrency — must match the quotation's current `version`), `productId`, optional `variantId`, `quantity`, `billingType`.

Price is resolved via `PricingService.resolvePrice` (folder 03) and snapshotted onto the line — it will NOT silently reprice later if the price list changes.

**Output (201):** the whole quotation again, now with this line and `version` bumped to 2. Every mutation endpoint returns the full quotation, not just the line, so the client always has fresh live totals.

**409 VERSION_CONFLICT** with `{expectedVersion, currentVersion}` if `expectedVersion` is stale — see folder 06 for a live repro.
Same shape as above. Quotation version moves to 3; `summary.netBeforeTax` becomes 1000+200=1200.00 (both lines still at 0% discount here).
Same live-computed numbers as the previous response — this is T6.5's "live margin indicator": re-fetching without changing anything reproduces identical totals, computed fresh every time.
Confirms the status stuck: `status: "PENDING_APPROVAL"`, `version: 5`. Lines/summary are unchanged from before submit — submitting doesn't alter commercial terms, only lifecycle state.

item.name: 06 - Quotation Line Editing (quantity, remove, version conflict)
item.description: A second, separate quotation used to demonstrate PATCH /api/quotations/{id}'s two commands and a real optimistic-concurrency conflict, without disturbing the Gold fixture in folder 05.

request.description: Same as folder 05's first request. Captures into `quotation2Id`/`quotation2Version`.

**Output (400):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Cannot submit a quotation with no lines", "details": { "id": "..." } } }
```
Moves quotation #2 to version 2. Captures the new line's id into `quotation2LineId`.

Hardcodes `expectedVersion: 1` — stale now that the previous request already bumped it to 2. This simulates two people (or a retried request) editing the same quotation.

**Output (409):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "VERSION_CONFLICT", "message": "This resource has been modified since it was last read", "details": { "id": "...", "expectedVersion": 1, "currentVersion": 2 } } }
```
The client is expected to re-fetch (GET the quotation), read the real current version, and retry — never blindly overwrite.

**Input:** `expectedVersion` plus **exactly one** of `updateLineQuantity: {lineId, quantity}` or `removeLineId` (the schema rejects both-or-neither with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`).

**Output (200):** quotation version -> 3, the line's `quantity: 3`, `netBeforeTax`/`marginAmount` scaled accordingly (3000.00 / 900.00 at 0% discount).
**Output (200):** quotation version -> 4, `lines: []`, `summary` back to all-zero/null-margin.

item.name: 07 - Access Control & Error Cases
item.description: The same endpoints, called by the wrong role/actor/id, to show the exact error envelope (T0.3) for each failure mode.

request.description:
No auth header at all — `getRequestActor` resolves to `null`.

**Output (401):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED", "message": "Authentication is required", "requestId": "..." } }
```

item.name: POST /api/products — Sales Rep tries an Admin-only write (403)

request.description:
SALES_REP is a valid, authenticated internal actor — just not ADMIN.

**Output (403):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "FORBIDDEN", "message": "Administrator access is required" } }
```

item.name: POST /api/quotations/{id}/lines — Manager tries a Sales-Rep-only write (403)

request.description:
TAD SS6: Manager has **Read** on quotations, not write, even though Manager isn't `CUSTOMER` and passes `requireInternal` elsewhere.

**Output (403):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "FORBIDDEN", "message": "Requires one of the following roles: SALES_REP" } }
```

item.name: GET /api/quotations/{id} — Manager CAN read any quotation (200)

request.description: Contrast with the previous request — read access is broader than write access for this role.

**Output (404):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "Quotation not found", "details": { "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" } } }
```

Fails Zod validation before it ever reaches the service (`priceListId` missing, `customerId` not a UUID).

**Output (400):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Request validation failed", "details": { "fieldErrors": { "customerId": ["Invalid uuid"], "priceListId": ["Required"] } } } }
```

Run this against the folder-05 quotation *after* it has already been submitted once.

**Output (409):**
```json
{ "error": { "code": "INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION", "message": "Only a Draft quotation can be submitted", "details": { "id": "...", "status": "PENDING_APPROVAL" } } }
```
The same code/shape covers trying to add/remove lines or change discounts once a quotation has left Draft.
